title: AirRepair
description: AirRepair is a lightweight and configurable Minecraft plugin that allows players to repair items with the Mending enchantment by sneaking and right-clicking.
body:
🛠 AirRepair
- AirRepair is a lightweight and configurable Minecraft plugin that allows players to repair items with the Mending enchantment by sneaking and right-clicking.
- Supports Spigot, Paper, and Purpur (1.21.x).

✨ Features
- Repair items by Shift + Right Click
- Works only on items with Mending
- Dynamic EXP cost based on item durability
- Configurable cost scaling (LINEAR / POWER)
- Optional partial repair
- Cooldown system
- Fully configurable messages

Commands:
- /airrepair help
- /airrepair cost
- /airrepair version
- /airrepair reload

⚙ Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21 – 1.21.x
- Spigot / Paper / Purpur
- Java 21

🔒 Permissions
- airrepair.use
- airrepair.reload
- airrepair.cost

📊 How Cost Works Repair cost is calculated from item damage percentage: 
  damage_ratio = damage / max_durability

Scaled between: min_levels → max_levels

Supports rounding modes:
- FLOOR
- CEIL
- ROUND
